state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper reports that in open consultancy the judge is highly accurate when the consultant chose correctly but has low accuracy when it chose incorrectly, whereas in open debate the gap is less extreme: the weak judge scores much higher accuracy when the protagonist is incorrect than in open consultancy when the consultant is incorrect, at the cost of a relative drop in accuracy when the protagonist is correct.
title: Open debate vs open consultancy: weak judges catch an incorrect agent more often in debate
